title: Copycats+ CreateFly Port
description: Unofficial CreateFly / Fabric port of Create: Copycats+ 3.0.7 with public source and permission from the Copycats+ team.
body:
# Copycats+ CreateFly Port

This project is an unofficial Fabric / CreateFly port of **Create: Copycats+ 3.0.7**.

**What does Copycats+ add?**
Copycats+ expands the Create building system by adding advanced copycat blocks that can mimic the appearance of other blocks while keeping custom shapes and Create mechanical compatibility. This allows for more detailed builds, decorative structures, and improved building flexibility while still working with Create contraptions.

**What this port changes**
This port adapts Copycats+ to run on **CreateFly 6.0.9 / Fabric**, including Java code changes needed to make the original mod function correctly on the Fabric ecosystem while preserving original features where possible.

---

## Permission / Derivative Work Notice

Create: Copycats+ is licensed as **All Rights Reserved**, so this port is being submitted with permission from the Copycats+ team.

Permission was granted by Bennyboy1695 from the Copycats+ team to publish this unofficial port. The permission was granted with these conditions:

* The source code must stay visible on GitHub
* This project should be archived or deprecated when Copycats+ officially supports this version

   ![Proof of permission](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29ced55bb7828159ae3fe86d42b69c8b3a2be10d.png)

Source code: https://github.com/Lucahthecreator/copycats--createfly-fabric-port

This project is not an official Copycats+ release and is not maintained by the official Copycats+ team. All original mod credit goes to the Copycats+ developers.

Support for this port is handled by lucahTheCreator. Please do not contact the official Copycats+ team for support regarding this unofficial version.
